ranked.headline: Joint histology, spatial and single-cell data correct and extend tissue transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Multimodal tissue methods now reconstruct and align spatial and single-cell transcriptomes using histology and atlas references.

ranked.headline: Generative models of omics data tested for robustness to noise and hidden variability
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell and multi-omics preprints and publications assess predictive models by robustness to missing inputs, outliers and latent variability.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines span target evidence, spectra, and molecular dataset curation
ranked.summary: Recent items pair literature-scale evidence mining with benchmarking and deep models for target validation and molecule annotation.

ranked.headline: STR variation and haplotype-resolved assemblies refine population and variant inference
ranked.summary: Denser variant representations, from genome-wide STRs to haplotype-resolved assemblies, now extend ancestry and structural variant inference.

ranked.headline: Flexible and disordered protein predictions tested against experimental observables
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair measured binding and SAXS data with benchmarks of AI cofolding and ensemble methods for disordered and flexible proteins.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer regulatory context from RNA, DNA, and epigenomic inputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair multimodal and graph-based learning with RNA and gene regulation prediction beyond raw sequence alone.

ranked.headline: Protein language models and 3D graph learning are applied to peptide design and prediction
ranked.summary: Learned sequence and structure models now target antimicrobial peptide generation and bioactive peptide prediction, alongside TCR-pMHC and CAR-T modeling.

ranked.headline: External reference data constrain structural model refinement and assessment
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool couple cryo-EM maps, MD reference data, and AI model metrics to structural modeling workflows.

ranked.headline: Read-level tools assign taxa and parse rDNA and ITS regions from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints validate alignment-based and alignment-free tools for assigning mixed plant, metatranscriptomic and long-read sequences to taxa and loci.

ranked.headline: Transformer embeddings are tested for which biological structure they actually encode
ranked.summary: Foundation model representations are now probed directly for encoded localization, interaction, and regulatory structure rather than assumed from architecture.

ranked.headline: Sequence models targeting unseen labels, splice annotation, and mutation pathogenicity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark deep models and propose data-efficient predictors for enzyme, splice, and mutation tasks.

ranked.headline: Sequencing frameworks map tRNA structure, modification, and RBP-RNA binding
ranked.summary: Single-read and large-scale sequencing methods now resolve tRNA modifications, structures, and protein-RNA interactions at transcriptome scale.

ranked.headline: Statistical frameworks for batch, phylogeny, and uncertainty in omics inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published NAR study add phylogeny-aware and batch-corrected inference tools for omics benchmarking and integration.

ranked.headline: Learned models target input design for single-cell and genome-scale regulation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one 2026 publication apply learned models to single-cell and genome architecture data using purpose-built inputs rather than raw features.

ranked.headline: Graph and multi-omics models predict drug-target and clinical outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend graph and attention models to drug-target, microbiome and omics prediction, alongside feature screening benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Multi-evidence scoring maps proteome motifs, complexes, and secretome folds across taxa
ranked.summary: Proteome-wide tools now combine motif, homology, structure, and phylogenetic evidence into quantified scores for comparative genomics.

ranked.headline: Learned models guide design of AAV capsids, mRNA lipid carriers, and drug pharmacokinetics
ranked.summary: Foundation models and reinforcement learning are shifting biomolecular property prediction toward closed-loop, property-conditioned design.

ranked.headline: Pangenomes and long-read assemblies link structural variants to crop traits
ranked.summary: Long-read pangenomes now tie assembly-scale structural and TE variation to fruit color, disease resistance, and climate adaptation.

ranked.headline: Force transmission across scales governs confluent tissue and epithelial mechanics
ranked.summary: Explicit mechanical models now link junction adhesion, nuclear deformation and multicellular force balance across tissue scales.

ranked.headline: Pipelines quantify individual molecular states from noisy single-molecule measurements
ranked.summary: Single-molecule imaging and tracking now depend on reference-free statistics and software that quantify event-level reliability.

ranked.headline: Synaptic tuning and efficiency bound what neural decoders and spiking networks can extract
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie synaptic weight structure, conductance, and connection-type constraints to limits on what neural activity can convey.

ranked.headline: Protein and codon language models analyzed for internal mechanisms and inference
ranked.summary: Pretrained biological language models are now probed mechanistically and applied to allergen discovery and codon-level sequence modeling.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics and Mendelian randomization nominate MASLD liver genes
ranked.summary: Integrative omics pipelines, cross-platform tools and synthetic sequence models now move inference from single datasets toward prioritized targets.

ranked.headline: Spatial entropy, mobility networks and genetic maps quantify structured dependence
ranked.summary: Methods now quantify how spatial arrangement, human mobility and genetic relatedness shape observed biological patterns.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free k-mer models classify viral and bacterial genomes from sequence content
ranked.summary: Alignment-free sequence models now resolve variant and pathogenic features directly from sequence content rather than assembly-based comparisons.

ranked.headline: Computational strategies expand peptide and proteoform identification from MS data
ranked.summary: Repository-scale spectral resources and benchmarked workflows now let computational pipelines extend peptide identification beyond conventional searches.

ranked.headline: Models link protein binding and chromatin states to 3D genome organization
ranked.summary: Multimodal integration of binding profiles, chromatin states, and spatial readouts now enables quantitative inference of 3D regulatory architecture.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic and data-driven models recover adaptation and morphogenetic dynamics
ranked.summary: Minimal analytical models and data-driven modes are now tested against hawk motion, crop growth, and Perturb-seq data.

ranked.headline: Computational models predict ligand binding and refine macromolecular ensemble accuracy
ranked.summary: GPU-accelerated screening platforms and active learning benchmarks are being tested against docking-based simulations and synthetic ensemble challenges.

ranked.headline: Structural constraints and mutation probes test protein and antibody sequence models
ranked.summary: Sequence models are increasingly judged on biological fidelity, as structure predictors and PLM surrogates face adversarial and constraint-based tests.

ranked.headline: Methylation mapping and radiation-induced genome instability in human genomes
ranked.summary: Higher-resolution methylation and conservation analyses are paired with genome-stability readouts after irradiation and epigenome editing.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomic identity of single cells is encoded diffusely across tissue-level axes
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomic methods now test how cell identity and regulatory coupling vary across human skin, melanoma and patient tumors.

ranked.headline: Testing structure prediction and ML potentials against experimental references
ranked.summary: AlphaFold3, MACE-based potentials, and FRET-guided selection are now tested against experimental structures, energetics, and transfer efficiencies.

ranked.headline: Computational Inference of Signaling and Proteolytic Networks from Proteomics
ranked.summary: Recent publications benchmark kinase pathway inference and introduce dynamic and degradation-based network models for proteomic data.

ranked.headline: Learned models map candidate loci and shared liability from genotypes and imaging
ranked.summary: Neural, contrastive, and multivariate models now yield GWAS loci and shared genetic liability from genotype and MRI data.

ranked.headline: Simulation and workflow tools for viral, sequencing read, and selection analyses
ranked.summary: Updated simulators and an automated workflow add HLA-aware viral evolution, accelerated read generation, and HyPhy selection analyses.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and latent RNA features sharpen gene regulatory and trait inference
ranked.summary: Lineage barcodes, population-scale simulation, and multimodal benchmarks now let single-cell and bulk transcriptome data evaluate regulatory claims directly.
